_note: How Nyxie wakes (hunters/gimmicks/nyxie.rs). Godot game/config/game_config.gd: NYXIE_TIMER_DELAY 120, NYXIE_EMPTY_DELAY 10, NYXIE_DESPAWN_RANGE 7, NYXIE_DISPEL_HALF_ANGLE 0.33, NYXIE_SPAWN_DISTANCE 10. dead_delay and dead_spawn_distance are ours (owner request): once the flashlight is dead (charge empty, the lamp cannot light) she appears after dead_delay seconds, dead_spawn_distance cells from the runner, instead of waiting timer_delay. A live beam within despawn_range sends her back, as for the timer wake. A lamp that stays dead until empty_delay still ends in the inescapable catch. dead_delay must not exceed empty_delay. The wake is the same on every difficulty. ignore_activation_gate (owner request): true = a dead flashlight brings her even before the difficulty's hunter activation count (Relaxed 3 relays, Standard 1, Hard and Nightmare 0). The Infinite route's level 0 has no Nyxie in its streamed lineup (Godot), so with this on the game makes one dormant Nyxie there the first frame the flashlight is dead; she wakes after dead_delay and escalates to the empty_delay lamp kill with no relay recovered, has no timer_delay darkness wake on level 0, and no other hunter is affected. false = level 0 has no Nyxie, as in Godot.
